has-part.doc: parthood: a process has temporal parts, a material entity material parts, a plan its components

phase.doc: a phase of an experiment: a temporal part that is a process

step.doc: an action that is part of a phase

has-component.doc: a part of a plan or of an information entity

contains.doc: location: a culture is in a well, it is not part of it

located-in.doc: what is contained in a part is located in the whole

realizes.doc: an action realizes a part of the plan: an exposure, an observation, a comparison

has-participant.doc: a participant of a part of a process participates in the process

unit.doc: an experimental unit: what is treated, kept and observed

site.doc: the material entity that holds the units

specifies.doc: the plan of an experiment: neither parthood nor participation

treatment.doc: the plan assigned to a unit

belief.doc: the information entity an experiment reads and updates

process.name: process
process.doc: something that happens; its parts are processes

material-entity.name: material-entity
material-entity.doc: a thing; its parts are things

plan-specification.name: plan-specification
plan-specification.doc: what is to be done; its components are plan specifications

information-entity.name: information-entity
information-entity.doc: what is known or asked; its components are information entities

phase.name: phase
phase.doc: a temporal part of an experiment

cultivation-phase.name: cultivation-phase
cultivation-phase.doc: the units are treated and kept under the shared conditions

analysis-phase.name: analysis-phase
analysis-phase.doc: the observations are interpreted and compared

experiment.name: experiment
experiment.doc: an activity that answers a question by producing insights

hypothesis-discriminating-experiment.name: hypothesis-discriminating-experiment
hypothesis-discriminating-experiment.doc:
the question asks which of several candidate hypotheses holds; the experiment changes a belief
over them, and its answer is the posterior

comparative-experiment.name: comparative-experiment
comparative-experiment.doc:
units are treated differently, kept under shared conditions and observed the same way;
comparisons between units determine the effects of the treatments. Its procedure yields three phases
procedure: (rule (each unit) (yields (an action (kind observation) (in (the observation-phase))) (an action (kind interpretation) (in (the analysis-phase)))))

controlled-experiment.name: controlled-experiment
controlled-experiment.doc:
one unit is an untreated control, it stays untreated, and every comparison isolates exactly one
exposure: its two units differ in that exposure only, and it is the exposure whose effect the comparison determines

challenge-rescue-experiment.name: challenge-rescue-experiment
challenge-rescue-experiment.doc:
units are injured by a challenge; one is then given a rescue after a delay. A validity comparison
(comparator vs control) establishes the challenge's effect and licenses the primary comparison (rescued vs
comparator), which determines the rescue's effect and updates the belief over models of recovery
